lots.title: Lots
lots.subtitle: Purchases by lot, physical count and testing progress
lots.search: Search by code, reference or supplier…
lots.empty_hint: Register a lot purchase to start counting and testing.
lots.new_hint: The lot code is generated automatically. Add one line per equipment type (brand, model, processor…) with the purchased quantity.
lots.unexpected_title: Item that was not in the lot
lots.unexpected_hint: Record what showed up during the count and was not in the purchase. It will be marked “unexpected” and added to the counted total.
lots.confirm_close_msg: Units can no longer be added and quantities cannot change. You can reopen it if needed.
lots.confirm_finish_msg: {{pending}} line(s) still need to be counted. Finish counting anyway?
lots.delete_lot_msg: The lot and its lines will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
lots.delete_lot_msg_units: Lot {{code}} will be deleted along with its {{count}} registered unit(s). Any reservation on them will be released. This cannot be undone.
lots.doc_no_template: There is no lot document designed. Create one in Settings → Labels.
lots.skip_testing_hint: Units in this lot can be registered and sold right away, without going one by one through testing (useful when the lot is sold whole or loose without checking each PC).
lots.sell_complete_msg: The remaining units for each lot line will be generated at once (available, untested), and quick sale will open with all of them.
lots.no_lines_hint: Add one line per purchased equipment type.
lots.off_lines_hint: Units added to the lot that match none of the purchased lines
lots.unlinked_units: {{n}} unit(s) of this lot are not linked to any line (they do not match what was purchased).
lots.no_units: No units of this lot have been registered yet.

rep.report_hint: Lines with expected, counted, difference and tested.
rep.units_hint: All registered units, with grades, status and location.

lots.delete_empty_msg: Lot {{code}} and its lines will be deleted. It has no units or counts yet. This cannot be undone.
lots.delete_only_empty: A closed lot cannot be deleted. Reopen it first if you need to delete it.

import.title: Import equipment
import.subtitle: Load many units at once from a CSV file (for example, an Excel inventory saved as CSV). They become available right away, without going through testing, inside a new lot.
import.type_hint: The units in the file are loaded as this type (brand, model, processor…).
import.lot_reference_hint: A name to identify this import lot (filled in from the file name).
import.extra_cols_hint: These file columns don't match any known field. Check the ones you want saved in each unit's notes.
import.summary: {{created}} of {{total}} unit(s) will be created · {{skipped}} will be skipped
import.new_values: {{n}} new value(s) will be added to the catalogs

importTech.title: Import units (technical control)
importTech.subtitle: For the technical-control inventory file (with a column giving each row's own type: laptop, micro, PC SFF...). Columns are recognized automatically by their header, no mapping needed. If the file mixes several lots (LOTE column), a new lot is created for each one.
importTech.step1_hint: Upload the CSV in the technical-control format. No need to pick an equipment type: each row carries its own in its own column.
importTech.lots_summary: {{n}} lot(s) will be created, one for each value of the LOTE column.
importTech.grade_warnings: {{n}} row(s) had a grade (cosmetic or functional) that doesn't match any valid code: left without that grade, noted for manual review.
